battle.name: 羅斯-拜占庭戰爭
battle.brief: 公元860年夏，北方羅斯聯軍約二三百艘船隻自黑海南下，突入博斯普魯斯，兵臨君士坦丁堡。聯軍避開帝國海軍，渡過金角灣、夜襲布萊克爾奈城郊，掠走教會寶物；帝國海陸軍合圍，聯軍船隊終被秋風暴摧毀而北返。卡面的希臘重步兵屬古典方陣，其盾牆餘緒在拜占庭近衛步兵與北歐斧兵之間仍可辨認。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場戰爭是北方羅斯聯軍與拜占庭帝國在公元860年夏天的一場正面衝突，交戰地點就在君士坦丁堡的海牆之外與北郊城區。拜占庭一方以皇帝米海爾三世為名義領袖：這位在西元842年阿爾西尼烏斯王朝覆亡後即位的年輕君主，此時面對的是攝政內廷、宦官集團，以及在小亞細亞出身的馬其頓人將軍巴西爾所形成的軍方勢力；牧首福提奧斯於858年被貶，861年才復位，因此860年之際教會與宮廷之間的裂痕尚未癒合。帝國的守備由幾層構成：駐紮在赫布多蒙、扼住博斯普魯斯入口的帝國海軍與水手軍團；狄奧多西城牆沿線的海門守軍與各段城防的雇傭兵；由首都軍區與色雷斯主題區抽調的陸軍步兵；以及近衛 Scholai 與後來編成的玄兵近衛（Ekkoubitoroi）。這些步兵裝備大盾、長矛與頭盔，組織上已不是古典方陣，但仍保存希臘重步兵式的密結盾牆觀念。羅斯一方則是多族裔的海上聯軍：瓦良格人（北歐維京系）、斯拉夫人與波羅的海沿岸的芬系部族為主體，部分編年史還提到可薩人參與；他們以掠奪為目的遠征，由阿斯科爾德與迪爾這對羅斯統治者或某位北歐首領率領，兵力估計在兩百至三百艘船之間。第三方並非旁觀者：860年之際拜占庭正與保加爾人交鋒，可薩與羅斯的動作因此帶有牽制帝國的意味；而拜占庭對北方的教會論述，把這次襲擊定性為野蠻人對基督教世界的進犯。
countriesEn: This war was a direct clash between a northern Rus' coalition and the Byzantine Empire in the summer of AD 860, fought off the sea walls of Constantinople and in the northern suburbs of the city. On the Byzantine side the nominal head was the emperor Michael III: a young sovereign who had come to the throne in 842 when the Amorian dynasty fell, and who in 860 was caught between the regency court, the eunuch faction, and the military ascendancy of Basil the Macedonian, a general of humble Anatolian origin; the patriarch Photios had been deposed in 858 and was only restored in 861, so the rift between Church and court was still open. The imperial defences were built in layers: the fleet and its marines posted at the Hebdomon, holding the entrance of the Bosporus; the gate guards along the Theodosian sea walls and the hired troops manning each stretch of the circuit; foot soldiers drawn from the Opsikion and the Thracesian theme; and the Scholai together with the Excubitores guard formed later in the century. That infantry carried large shields, spears and helmets, and was organised no longer as a classical phalanx but still preserved the idea of the tightly meshed Greek shield wall. The Rus' side was a multi-ethnic sea coalition: Varangians of Scandinavian stock, Slavs and Finnic peoples of the Baltic littoral forming the core, with some chronicles also naming Cumans among the participants; they came for plunder rather than territory, were led by the Rus' rulers Askold and Dir or by some Norse chief, and brought a fleet of perhaps two to three hundred ships. Third parties were not mere spectators: Byzantium was at war with the Bulgars around 860, so the movements of the Cumans and the Rus' carried the meaning of a diversion; and the Byzantine view of the north framed this raid as a barbarian incursion against the Christian world.
people: 決定這場衝突走向的關鍵人物大半在拜占庭一側。皇帝米海爾三世是名義上的最高統帥，但軍政實權長期由攝政太后狄奧多拉與其後的內廷宦官分據；他在軍中缺乏威望，東羅馬宮廷史書對這次恥辱的記載因此格外刻薄。牧首福提奧斯是另一個關鍵人物：860年他仍在流放地，卻在襲擊之後被召回君士坦丁堡，861年復位，並撰寫頌詞追述羅斯人的劫掠，把這場圍擾稱為「福提奧斯之城的圍擾」。寫下最細節那段劫掠記錄的是薩克索的尼基塔斯，他記錄羅斯人破開布萊克爾奈教會的銅門、奪走牧首的十字架、聖母的紫袍以及金銀器皿；連續編年史的作者狄奧菲蘭則記錄了帝國海軍出擊與羅斯船隊最後被風暴摧毀的過程。帝國海軍的指揮官在史料中沒有留下姓名，但正是他們封住博斯普魯斯、與陸軍會合包圍登岸的聯軍，才把主動權一點一點收回。羅斯方面有兩類人物值得留意：主謀阿斯科爾德與迪爾，據《往古紀年》記載，他們在奧列格之前治理羅斯；還有被北歐世界記住的武人哈爾夫丹，瑞典奧蘭島希吉亞索菲亞教堂出土的符文石提到此人率「丹麥人」南下並與一位「王后」有金錢交易，許多學者把這塊石頭與860年的劫掠連在一起。另一個耐人尋味的人是狄奧多西·斯特拉特拉特斯，這位北歐血統的將軍855年被羅斯俘虜並送回君士坦丁堡，日後成為東羅馬名將，他的經歷恰好說明此時北方戰士與帝國宮廷之間已有直接往返的管道。
peopleEn: Most of the decisive figures in this conflict stood on the Byzantine side. The emperor Michael III was the nominal commander in chief, but real military and political authority was divided between the regency of the empress Theodora and, after her death, the palace eunuchs; he had little standing with the army, and the court historians wrote of the humiliation with corresponding bitterness. The other key man was the patriarch Photios: still in exile when the raid came, he was summoned back to Constantinople and restored in 861, and he composed an encomium recounting the plunder of the Rus', describing the siege as the siege of the city of Photios. The man who left the most detailed record of the looting was Niketas of Saxe, who recorded how the Rus' broke open the bronze doors of the church of Blachernae and carried off the patriarch's cross, the purple robe of the Theotokos and gold and silver plate; Theophanes the Continuator recorded the sortie of the imperial fleet and the destruction of the Rus' fleet in the storm. The commanders of the imperial navy left no names in the sources, but it was their sealing of the Bosporus and their junction with the land army that gradually wrested the initiative back. Two kinds of men on the Rus' side deserve notice: the plotters Askold and Dir, who according to the Primary Chronicle governed the Rus' before Oleg, and the warrior Halfdan remembered in the Scandinavian world, named on a runestone from Hagia Sophia on the island of Öland in Sweden, which speaks of the Danes going south and of money passing between them and a queen; many scholars connect that stone with the plunder of 860. Another telling figure is Theodore Stratelates, a general of Norse blood who was captured by the Rus' in 855 and sent to Constantinople, and who was later a celebrated general of the East Roman state; his career shows that by then there were already direct channels running between northern warriors and the imperial court.
kits: 卡面這件希臘重步兵的兵器屬於公元前五世紀的希臘世界：圓形厚盾（aspis）、約兩公尺長的直矛（dory）、青銅或亞麻緊身甲（linothorax）、科林斯式青銅頭盔與脛甲，價值在於盾牌相接時形成的整體防禦。它與860年的君士坦丁堡相隔一千三百六十年，不可能出現在這場戰役中；需要說明的是，古典方陣的戰法在九世紀早已不復存在。實際在場的雙方裝備如下。拜占庭步兵以「斯庫塔托伊」為主，即主題區的重裝步兵，裝備大盾（skouton）、長矛（kontos）、鐵盔與札甲或皮甲，近衛 Scholai 與玄兵近衛則配以更好的護甲；輔助兵種有稅弓手（toxotes）、弩手、投石手與專司拆毀城門的攻城技術人員。帝國海軍是雙排槳的德隆蒙（dromon），帆槳並用、船首裝撞角，另有裝載燃油的燃火船（pyrophoros）與供人登岸的小艇；金角灣口在九世紀初已有以鐵鏈與浮柵封鎖的安排，羅斯人便是靠小艇從封鎖線北側繞過去的。羅斯聯軍的北歐核心是長船（drakkar）上的斧兵與矛兵，配圓盾、斧、矛與投槍，靠搶灘與夜襲取勝；斯拉夫與芬系步兵則以弓、矛為主，適合劫掠鄉野。攻城手段非常原始：以斧劈開銅門、以繩梯攀牆、以小艇接應，沒有撞車，也沒有攻城塔。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card belongs to the Greek world of the fifth century BC: the heavy round shield (aspis), the roughly two-metre thrusting spear (dory), the bronze or linen cuirass (linothorax), the Corinthian bronze helmet and greaves; its value lay in the fact that when shields were locked side by side, the front of the formation was stronger than any single man. It stands some thirteen hundred and sixty years away from Constantinople in 860 and could not have been present in this campaign; the classical phalanx had in any case been gone for a long time. What was actually on the spot was as follows. Byzantine infantry was for the most part the Skoutatoi, the heavy foot of the themes, armed with the big infantry shield (skouton), the spear (kontos), iron helmets and either lamellar or leather armour, while the Scholai and the Excubitores were better armoured still; the supporting arms included tax archers (toxotes), crossbowmen, slingers and the engineers who worked on gates. The imperial navy consisted of the double-banked dromon, worked with both oar and sail and carrying a ram at the bow, together with the pyrophoros, a lighter hull loaded with burning oil, and the small boats used to ferry landing parties; since the early ninth century the mouth of the Golden Horn had been closed off with an iron chain and a floating boom, and the Rus' got past that line in their small boats to the north of it. The Scandinavian core of the Rus' coalition were axe-men and spearmen in longships (drakkar), armed with round shields, axes, spears and javelins, and winning by the surprise of a landing and by night attacks; the Slav and Finnic foot were bowmen and spearmen, better suited to ravaging the countryside. Their siege methods were primitive: axes against the bronze doors, rope ladders against the wall, small boats to take off the loot — no battering rams and no siege towers.
tactics: 羅斯聯軍的整套作戰避開了兩樣東西：一是拜占庭的艦隊，二是帝國重步兵的方陣。船隊自黑海北岸南下，進入博斯普魯斯後並不強攻海峽，也不直取赫布多蒙的御苑與海軍基地，而是先在金角灣南口下錨，觀察守備。真正的打法是夜襲：士兵乘小艇渡過金角灣，從海牆一側登陸，目標是北岸的布萊克爾奈教區與凱普塞拉皇宮區；破門之後迅速掠取財物，隨即退回船上。得手之後，聯軍不再嘗試攻城，而是把戰爭變成封鎖與海掠：截住海峽往來的商船，掠奪色雷斯海岸的村落與莊園，冬初前在博斯普魯斯與達達尼海峽一帶游弋，等待下一次季節性遠征。這套戰術的要害在於把主動權交給船，把陸戰交給突襲；一旦需要在陸地上正面對峙，希臘式的重步兵傳統所保證的那種密結盾牆就會發揮作用。拜占庭的應對也沿着這一點展開：海軍封鎖海峽入口與海上退路，陸軍（首都軍區與色雷斯主題區的步兵，配合雇傭的瓦良格人與北歐傭兵）沿色雷斯海岸推進，把登岸的聯軍趕回船上；城牆守軍與城內民兵守住海門。最後一擊來自天氣：秋季的東北風暴在黑海與海峽一帶掀起的巨浪摧毀了聯軍大量船隻，北歐水手在無遮蔽的海上無力應對，倖存者於深秋北返，戰事就此結束。
tacticsEn: The whole Rus' plan avoided two things: the Byzantine fleet, and the phalanx of imperial heavy infantry. The fleet came down from the northern shore of the Black Sea and, once into the Bosporus, neither forced the straits nor struck straight at the imperial palace and naval base of the Hebdomon; it anchored off the mouth of the Golden Horn first and watched the defences. The real method was a night attack: the men crossed in small boats, landed on the sea wall side and aimed at the church quarter of Blachernae and the imperial quarter of Kypsela on the north bank; once the doors were broken they took what they could carry and fell back to their ships. After that the coalition made no further attempt to take the city by storm, but converted the war into blockade and maritime plunder: cutting off merchant traffic through the straits, raiding the villages and estates of the Thracian coast, and cruising the Bosporus and the Dardanelles until the season for the next raid was gone. The point of the method was to leave the decision to the ships and to hand the land battle to the surprise; once a set-piece confrontation on land became unavoidable, the close-meshed shield wall guaranteed by the Greek heavy infantry tradition would have had its effect. The Byzantine reply worked along exactly that line: the fleet closed the entrance of the straits and the sea route of escape, the land army — foot from the Opsikion and the Thracesian theme, with hired Varangians and Norse mercenaries — pushed along the Thracian coast and drove the landed coalition back onto its ships, while the wall garrison and the city militia held the sea gates. The last blow came from the weather: a north-easterly gale in the Black Sea and the straits in autumn raised a sea that destroyed a great part of the Rus' fleet, and unshielded northern sailors had no answer to it; the survivors went north in late autumn and the war was over.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。羅斯聯軍的船隊，福提奧斯的頌詞與薩克索的尼基塔斯都提到「兩百艘以上」，近代學者按殘存線索多估在兩百至三百艘之間。圍擾的時段一般定在公元860年6月中旬至9月初，約三個月；結束這場戰役的風暴一般定於9月初，部分說法指9月2日。海路方面，從黑海北岸的羅斯勢力範圍繞過克里米亞南下、再穿博斯普魯斯與達達尼海峽，航程以一千五百公里上下估算。帝國的城防尺度可作對照：狄奧多西城牆連同海牆的周長約五公里，陸牆部分約二點五公里，牆高約十二米，牆基厚三公尺半至四公尺半，外側有寬約二十米的護城河；金角灣的封鎖鏈橫跨灣口，後面還有一線浮柵與欄障。帝國陸軍在戰役中投入的具體人數沒有留下可信記錄，能確認的是首都軍區與色雷斯主題區的部隊都被調動，並有雇傭的瓦良格人與北歐傭兵參與守城。雙方的死傷數字無從核實：帝國方面的損失主要是城郊被焚的房屋、教會器物與牲畜，聯軍方面的損失集中在風暴中失去的船隻，數目各執一詞。瑞典奧蘭島希吉亞索菲亞教堂出土的符文石（Sö 335）年代被定在860年代，是把這場劫掠寫進北歐見證的唯一物證。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The Rus' fleet is described in Photios' encomium and in Niketas of Saxe as numbering more than two hundred ships, and modern scholars, working from scattered indications, mostly put it between two and three hundred. The period of the blockade is generally dated from the middle of June of AD 860 to the beginning of September, roughly three months; the storm that ended the campaign is generally placed in early September, some accounts giving 2 September. By sea, the run from the Rus' sphere on the northern shore of the Black Sea, round the Crimea and down through the Bosporus and the Dardanelles, works out at something like fifteen hundred kilometres. The scale of the imperial defences provides a useful comparison: the Theodosian circuit, sea walls included, ran to about five kilometres, the land wall alone some two and a half kilometres, the wall stood about twelve metres high with a thickness of three and a half to four and a half metres at the base, and a moat about twenty metres wide ran along its outer side; a chain was stretched across the mouth of the Golden Horn, backed by a line of pontoons and barriers. No reliable figure survives for the number of imperial soldiers committed to the campaign; what can be confirmed is that units of the Opsikion and the Thracesian theme were moved, and that Varangians and other northern mercenaries were hired to hold the walls. Neither side's losses can be checked: on the Byzantine side the loss was chiefly the burnt and plundered suburb, the church plate and the livestock, and on the Rus' side it was concentrated in the ships lost in the storm, and each side gives its own count. The runestone found at Hagia Sophia on the island of Öland in Sweden (Sö 335), dated to the 860s, is the only material evidence that carries the sack into the Scandinavian record.
cause: 羅斯人為什麼在860年打到君士坦丁堡，史料沒有給出一份戰略理由，只能從結構上看。第一是財富的誘惑：拜占庭的首都被北歐世界視為富庶到不可思議的所在，羅斯聯軍這次遠征帶有明確的季節性掠奪性質，目標是財物，而不是土地與人口的控制。第二是航路與商貿：黑海北岸的羅斯勢力已經能控制通往黑海的路線，把拜占庭的絲綢、香料與金銀器皿運到北方，或者反過來直接奪走，是同一條利益鏈的兩端。第三是戰機：860年前後拜占庭正捲入與保加爾人的戰爭，即863年起的那場拜占庭-保加爾戰爭，帝國的兵馬與注意力被牽制在色雷斯方向，北方聯軍很清楚西都的海防與城防都可能空虛。第四是傳統與名分：羅斯方面的記載把這次行動放在阿斯科爾德與迪爾統治的年代，說他們「不曾有過任何謀劃，卻自行造了船隻並啟航」，這說明這類掠奪遠征在860年之前已是可重複的慣例，無須中央策劃也能成行。拜占庭一側則是另一套邏輯：教會與宮廷把北方民族描述為既掠奪又背叛盟約的蠻族，860年的襲擊因此被記成「野蠻人第二次蹂躪羅馬城」的前奏，而拜占庭的應對邏輯也在這次之後從「逐客」轉為「在黑海常駐巡邏」。
causeEn: Why the Rus' struck Constantinople in 860 is something no source sets out as a strategic plan; it can only be read from the structure of the situation. First, the pull of wealth: Byzantium's capital was believed in the northern world to be fabulously rich, and the Rus' expedition was plainly a seasonal raid for booty, aimed at goods rather than at holding land or people. Second, the shipping lane and the trade: the Rus' power on the northern shore of the Black Sea could already control the routes into that sea, and carrying Byzantine silk, spices and precious plate north, or simply seizing them, were two ends of the same chain of profit. Third, the opening: around 860 Byzantium was absorbed in war with the Bulgars, the Byzantine-Bulgarian war that began in 863, and the empire's soldiers and attention were being drawn towards Thrace, while the northern coalition knew very well that the sea defences and the garrison of the western capital might both be thin. Fourth, custom and entitlement: the Rus' record places this campaign in the years of the rule of Askold and Dir, who are said never to have planned anything, yet built their own ships and set sail, which shows that a raid of this kind was already a repeatable practice before 860 and needed no central scheme to launch. Byzantium's logic ran the other way: Church and court described the northern peoples as savages who plundered and broke their pledged faith, so the raid of 860 was written into history as a prelude to the second devastation of the Roman city by the barbarians, and the Byzantine response shifted from simply driving the raiders off to keeping a permanent watch in the Black Sea.
impact: 860年的圍擾拉開了羅斯與拜占庭之間長達近兩百年的衝突序幕，此後到1043年，兩個政權之間發生過十餘次大規模戰爭與掠奪。短期看，帝國的處境更壞：城郊被焚掠，牧首與宮廷的寶物被劫走，宗教上的羞辱感大於軍事上的損失，這正是米海爾三世在867年被巴西爾推翻、福提奧斯隨即被賜死、牧首位改由伊格納提奧斯接任的近因之一；福提奧斯教派與教宗之間的分裂，也就是福提奧斯之裂，也在這段亂局中定型為東西方教會的正式斷裂。中期看，掠奪轉化為條約：907年與911年奧列格與拜占庭皇帝訂立的條約，規定羅斯人可以在君士坦丁堡貿易、可以進入城市並且不需繳納過境稅，北方的掠奪者被寫成可以談判的對手，羅斯第一次以國家身份在拜占庭取得權利。長期看，這條航道把北歐與拜占庭世界縫在一起，最終通向988年弗拉基米爾受洗與羅斯受洗；被掠走的聖物（牧首的十字架、聖母的紫袍）在北方被當作珍寶與聖物保存，進入北歐的傳說與寶藏故事。帝國也在黑海學到了教訓：913年刻於克里米亞的銘文記錄拜占庭艦隊自君士坦丁堡巡航黑海、追擊並奪回被羅斯人劫走的物資，這是黑海常駐巡邏制度最早的物證之一。
impactEn: The siege of 860 opened a sequence of Rus'-Byzantine conflicts that ran for close to two centuries, with more than a dozen major wars and raids between the two states before 1043. In the short term the empire's position was the worse for it: the suburbs were burned and plundered, the treasures of the patriarch and of the palace were carried off, and the religious humiliation was larger than the military loss. That was one of the immediate reasons Michael III was overthrown by Basil in 867, Photios was put to death, and the see of St Peter was given to Ignatios; the rupture between the Photian party and the papacy, the Photian schism, also hardened during these years into a formal break between the eastern and western churches. In the medium term plunder turned into treaty: the agreements Oleg concluded with the Byzantine emperor in 907 and 911 gave the Rus' the right to trade in Constantinople, to enter the city and to be exempt from the tax on transit, so that a raider was written down as an adversary one could negotiate with, and the Rus' for the first time secured rights at Byzantium as a state. In the long term this sea lane stitched the north to the Byzantine world, and it ended in the baptism of Vladimir in 988 and the Christianisation of the Rus'; the objects carried off in the raid — the patriarch's cross, the purple robe of the Theotokos — were kept in the north as treasure and as relics, and passed into the legend of the Scandinavian world. Byzantium also drew a lesson: the inscription cut in Crimea in 913 records an imperial squadron cruising from Constantinople into the Black Sea, pursuing the Rus' and recovering goods they had carried off, and is among the earliest material proof of a permanent Byzantine patrol in that sea.
result: 就860年這一年而言，結果是明確的：羅斯聯軍沒有攻下君士坦丁堡。帝國城市守住了，聯軍只燒掠了北郊城區與教區的房屋、搶走了金銀器皿、牧首的十字架與聖母的紫袍，然後被帝國海陸兩軍的封鎖與追擊逼回海上，最後在九月初的風暴中損失了船隊的大半，於深秋帶著殘餘的戰利品北返。拜占庭這邊是「未失城、已失血」：城防與器物的損失真實存在，軍心的震動與宮廷的羞辱更難平復，米海爾三世的皇位也在此後數年動盪。從更長的視角看，這場戰爭的結果有兩層：對羅斯人而言，它證明北方聯軍有能力打到帝國首都並全身而退，此後的季節性掠奪不再需要冒險求戰，只需挑最有機會的季節與防守空隙出擊；對拜占庭人而言，它確立了黑海不能放任不管的方針，海峽封鎖與黑海巡邏成為此後兩個世紀的常態兵力配置。也正因如此，860年既是衝突的起點，也是日後羅斯-拜占庭條約關係的起點。
resultEn: For the year 860 itself the outcome is clear: the Rus' coalition never took Constantinople. The city held; the coalition burned and plundered the northern suburb and the church quarter, took the gold and silver plate, the patriarch's cross and the purple robe of the Theotokos, and was then driven back onto the water by the blockade and pursuit of the imperial fleet and land army, losing a large part of its fleet in the storm of early September and going north in late autumn with what remained of its loot. For Byzantium this was a defeat without a lost city: the losses in the defences and in plate were real, and the shock to morale and the humiliation at court were harder to absorb, and Michael III's throne was unstable in the years that followed. Seen over a longer span the result of the war has two layers. For the Rus' it proved that a northern coalition could reach the imperial capital and get away whole, so that the seasonal raids thereafter no longer needed to risk a pitched battle but only to pick the season and the gap in the defences that suited them. For the Byzantines it established that the Black Sea could not be left alone, and the closing of the straits and the patrol of the Black Sea became a permanent deployment of strength for the two centuries that followed. It is for that reason that 860 is at once the beginning of the conflict and the beginning of the treaty relationship between the Rus' and Byzantium.
